This call log constitutes empirical evidence of L.A. Care Health Plan's repeated, persistent, and unsolicited attempts to contact the plaintiff via telephone. Despite a strict written communication directive issued by the plaintiff on March 31, 2026, the plan's aggressive telephonic outreach persisted well into mid-April, in systematic violation of the patient's demand for a documented, written-only protocol.
summary: This forensic call log captures twelve unsolicited incoming calls from L.A. Care Health Plan between March 27 and April 10, 2026.
